7400.title: SDK host ESM imports are already repaired on main
7400.rootCauseOneLine: Inlining CommonJS cross-spawn into ESM caused unsupported dynamic require; main already externalizes the declared dependency.
7400.proposedFix: No new main change: retain the repair merged in PR #4178 on September 23, 2026. Validate an updated compatible SDK for old consumers.
7400.caveats: Verified current source SDK 0.6.138 on Linux/Node 22 in two clean checkouts. Old 0.4.87, macOS/Node 24, registry publication, and live host behavior not tested. Repro script and output are inline per reports repository policy.
